verdict.rationale: The evidence describes per-sandbox operations: claim, pause/resume, fork, snapshot and file management. Claiming additional sandboxes from a snapshot for parallel tasks (docs-29) and CLI orchestration in GitHub Actions (docs-27) are user-built patterns, not a documented bulk-operation capability. Nothing shows a batch endpoint or multi-item command that acts on many sandboxes or files at once, so this applicable axis gets none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
